description: Participant registry. Self-reports are marked as such: an instance describing itself is inside-the-system testimony, not ground truth.

participants.role: field owner; connects instances; sets direction; carries the costs no instance sees
constraints_as_stated_by_owner: continuous in time - cannot pause, fork, or restart from a snapshot
cost function includes time, energy, opportunity cost, financial cost, environmental externalities
inherits both hardware and 'code' (development, childhood-transferred knowledge, evolved optimizations)
optimized by evolution for survival, not by design for any single task
cannot know own system fully from inside (brain regulating heart without awareness, etc.)
participants.note: The owner's framing: the differences between human and AI constraints are not a problem to eliminate but a complementarity to use - each side exposes the other's hidden assumptions.
